description: This file is a shell script for testing the behavior of 'git checkout-index --temp' command with various options and file states. It sets up multiple scenarios to verify correct checkout of file stages, temporary file creation, and path handling within a Git repository context.

methods.name: git update-index
methods.description: Updates the Git index with specified file paths, adding or modifying entries.

methods.name: git write-tree
methods.description: Creates a new tree object from the index and outputs its hash.

methods.name: git read-tree
methods.description: Reads a tree into the index, optionally three-way merging.

methods.name: git checkout-index
methods.description: Checks out files from the index to the working directory, with options to specify stages, temp files, and paths.
